prompt: 根據短文，作者最可能同意哪一項？
text: Many people think night owls are lazy. However, studies suggest that sleep timing is partly inherited, so it is not simply a matter of effort.
options: 晚睡的習慣有一部分受遺傳影響
晚睡的人一定比較懶惰
睡眠時間完全由意志力決定
answer: 晚睡的習慣有一部分受遺傳影響

wrong.晚睡的人一定比較懶惰: 文中用 However 反駁這個看法，並沒有說一定懶惰。
wrong.睡眠時間完全由意志力決定: 文中說 not simply a matter of effort，否定了完全由努力決定。

why: partly inherited 表示部分受遺傳影響，作者用研究反駁刻板印象。
tip: however 之後常是作者真正的觀點。

prompt: 短文中 it 指的是什麼？
text: The city introduced a bike-sharing program last spring. It quickly became popular among commuters, and many say it saves them time.

wrong.去年春天: last spring 是時間，不會 became popular。
wrong.通勤者: commuters 是複數，與 it 的單數不符。

why: it 回指 a bike-sharing program，變得受歡迎的是計畫。
tip: 代名詞題：看單複數，再看語意。

prompt: 作者提到下列敘述，主要目的是什麼？
text: Some critics claim online classes are less effective. Yet a recent survey found that students in online classes performed as well as those in classrooms.

wrong.贊成批評者的看法: Yet 表示轉折，後面的調查結果與批評相反。
wrong.描述調查如何進行: 文中只提到結果，並沒有說明方法或流程。

why: Yet 帶出反證：線上課表現與教室相當，反駁批評者。
tip: Yet、But 後面常是作者真正想說的。

prompt: 混合題：選出最適合填入的詞。
text: The writer's tone in the passage is best described as _____, as she carefully weighs both sides without taking a strong position.

wrong.furious: furious 是憤怒，與 carefully weighs 平靜權衡不符。
wrong.sarcastic: sarcastic 是諷刺，與公平衡量兩邊的語氣不合。

why: weighs both sides 表示兩邊都考慮，語氣是平衡的 balanced。
tip: 語氣題：看是否情緒化、偏向一方。

prompt: 哪一句最適合作為這段文章的主旨句？
text: Volunteers clean beaches. Others plant trees. Some teach children to recycle.
options: Ordinary people can help protect the environment in many ways.
answer: Ordinary people can help protect the environment in many ways.

文中只提到志工清理海灘，並沒有說海灘總是髒的，此為過度推論。
文中說的是教導孩子回收，沒有說孩子不喜歡。

why: 三個例子都是人們以不同方式保護環境，主旨要能涵蓋全部。
tip: 主旨要涵蓋所有細節，不是單一細節。
say: Ordinary people can help protect the environment in many ways.

prompt: 作者使用 For instance 的目的是什麼？
text: Some animals adapt quickly. For instance, urban foxes have learned to hunt near busy streets.

wrong.提出反對意見: For instance 不是轉折詞，不會反對前面。
wrong.開始新的段落: For instance 是承接前句的舉例，不是新段落。

why: For instance 後面是具體例子，支持動物會快速適應。
tip: For instance 後面是例子，支持前一句。
say: For instance, urban foxes have learned to hunt near busy streets.

prompt: 根據短文，下列何者為真？
text: The cafe opens at 8 a.m. on weekdays and at 9 a.m. on weekends. It is closed on Mondays for cleaning.

wrong.週末八點開門: 週末是九點開門，不是八點。
wrong.週五不營業: 文中只說週一休息，週五屬於平日八點營業。

why: 文中明說 closed on Mondays，所以週一不營業。
tip: 事實題：回文章找證據，不要憑印象。

prompt: 混合題：選出最適合的答案。
text: The author's argument is weakened because the survey included _____ twenty people, which is too few to draw a general conclusion.

wrong.even: even 表示甚至，無法表達樣本太少。
wrong.hardly: hardly 是幾乎不，後面不能直接接數字 twenty people。

why: only twenty people 強調人數少，說明樣本不足。
say: The survey included only twenty people.

prompt: 作者對手機使用最可能的態度是什麼？
text: Phones are useful tools, but constant checking can make it hard to concentrate on homework.

wrong.完全禁止: 作者先說 useful tools，沒有主張完全禁止。
wrong.毫無用處: useful 已經肯定手機的用途。

why: but 前肯定用處，後指出過度使用的問題，態度是有條件肯定。
tip: 先肯定再轉折，態度通常是有條件地接受。

prompt: 哪一句最能正確概述這段文章？
text: Marie studied physics at night while working in a factory. Years later, she became the first woman to receive a professor's post at her university.
options: Marie overcame difficulties to achieve an academic career.
answer: Marie overcame difficulties to achieve an academic career.

文章沒有提到她對工作的感受，這是無證據的推測。
文中明說她晚上研讀物理，與此相反。

why: 概述要根據文中事實，克服困難並達成學術成就。
tip: 概述題避免加入文中沒有的感受。
say: Marie overcame difficulties to achieve an academic career.

prompt: Not all students agree. 這句話表示什麼？
text: Not all students agree with the new schedule.

wrong.所有學生都不同意: Not all 是部分否定，意思不是全部都不同意。
wrong.所有學生都同意: Not all students agree 表示並非全部同意，與全部同意相反。

why: not all 是部分否定，表示不是每個人，也就是有些人不同意。
tip: not all／not every 是部分否定。
say: Not all students agree with the new schedule.

prompt: 混合題：選出最適合的答案。
text: According to the passage, solar panels become _____ affordable each year as technology improves.

wrong.most: most 是最高級，需要 the，也不符合 each year 逐年增加的比較語意。
wrong.much: much 不能直接修飾 affordable 來表示逐漸變得更便宜。

why: become more + 形容詞 表示越來越…，each year 呼應逐步變化。
tip: 越來越…：become more + 形容詞。
say: Solar panels become more affordable each year.
